items.why: AMD is leading the tech rebound alongside Nvidia as the Nasdaq recovers and AI stocks see some buying.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
Nvidia is rebounding as lawmakers call CEO Jensen Huang to a closed-door briefing, and it is leading the tech recovery with AMD.
Fear is easing as the stock rout pauses and dip buyers offer support, with the Nasdaq attempting to recover.

market_note: Nasdaq futures up 1.79% and S&P futures up 0.79%, while the VIX falls 13.9% as fear eases.
summary: Stocks are bouncing back after the worst rout in 19 months, with AI names leading the recovery as dip buyers step in. The jobs report came in stronger than expected in October, which is pressuring the Fed.
